Hey,

Hope your week is going well! Just passing along a few things we wanted you to know about.

The corner protectors in our packaging are recycled and can be put in paper recycling. Monday is a public holiday for our office, so expect slower replies that day. When unloading, the cartons should stay upright and off any damp floor.

No need to write back, this is purely for your information. Thanks, and talk soon.

Rafi
Wren Ceramics
